segments.text: Bugun yarim saat o'qish bussa, albatta shu video darsini korin.
Biz Shweetsaran e-expertla wa halkora speakerlar Uzbekistan dan Shweetsaran turli lo'ykhla da AI lo'ykhalar disilab,
Aynan shu mazudu, Uzbekistan da 2026-inchi il anaqil suni tshrikban daromad tofkiliyabiz.
Agar sizam 2026-inchi il AI bilan hayatizda kana qadar ma'nada uzgayrtirmakchi busiz,
pastegi tugmanu basi video darsini korin.
Ma'ir imam bu sizge yen'i yon alish bolada.
